name: rayneo-token-broker
description: Cloudflare Worker + SQLite Durable Object Token Broker (Scheme A passive access-token mirror) for RayNeo CLI

BROKER_SECRET.description: Shared Bearer secret (>=32 chars) for iOS Loon and `rayneo sync`. Generate with `openssl rand -hex 32`. Optional `BROKER_READ_SECRET` / `BROKER_WRITE_SECRET` / `BROKER_ENCRYPTION_KEY` can also be added after deploy.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && wrangler deploy --dry-run
